cohort: Eighty neonates aged 0-28 days admitted with surgical emergencies were enrolled from a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and Department of Pediatric Surgery at a tertiary care referral hospital.
finding: Abnormal antenatal ultrasonography, inadequate prenatal care (fewer than four antenatal visits), maternal hypertension, and consanguinity were identified as significant predictors of adverse outcomes and extended hospital stays for neonates with surgical emergencies.
